svg.title: Aloes
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Five yellow angular/curved areas are visible, not a naturalistic aloe illustration. Exact signed title/date match the official sale caption. Both original2012and2026official photos show the same portrait sheet while the2012caption dimensions imply landscape; use observed paper ratio only and flag conflict. Pencil contours, signature and watercolour texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.christies.com/en/lot/lot-5623231; record christies-5623231; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
